goal: Maintain a local human-first Taiwan stock truth database with auditable official-data ingestion, CLI operations, Local Truth API access, server scheduling, backups, and notifications.
frozen_decisions: Use local SQLite as the core truth database.
Do not redesign the architecture away from the existing human-first spec and Local Truth API spec.
PWA must use structured API/Core results and must not parse CLI stdout.
Cloud Edge API/PWA is a separate non-open-source project; this repo only owns the Local Truth DB and local API/export boundary.
Official missing numeric data must not be invented or filled with 0.
Close dash placeholders are dataset-specific and must be filled from previous close only when proven, or excluded/rechecked according to the documented rule.
Batch state is managed through import_batches; special data handling is recorded through data_events.
Secrets, DB files, data files, logs, tmp files, historical CSV, and tokens must not be uploaded to GitHub.
Close monthly reconciliation stays separate from audit-month and is deferred.

decisions.decision: Attention and disposal notice primary keys include market.
decisions.reason: Avoid ambiguity and align with existing dataset patterns; add date+stock index for backtesting queries.

decisions.decision: Attention and disposal store original text instead of parsing clauses immediately.
decisions.reason: The text volume is small and downstream projects can extract clauses later.
User experience is better when daily update and cross-day correction are separate.

decisions.decision: Local API and cloud API are separate.
decisions.reason: Local server owns crawling, DB, strategy, and management; cloud receives lightweight JSON for public-facing PWA only.
